name: Romanticism
intro: From the 1760s to the 1860s, painters and sculptors in Spain, France, Britain, Germany and the United States turned from calm, rule-bound classicism to feeling, imagination, nature and the news of their own day. This section follows them through sixty-four works, with the facts of each object drawn from museum collection records.
homeDescription: Sixty-four works trace Romanticism from Fuseli, Blake and Goya to Géricault, Delacroix, Turner, Constable, Friedrich and the Hudson River School.
ldDescription: An artwork-by-artwork guide to Romantic art, 1760s–1860s, compiled from museum collection records.
